thread:
maria (PM): Finance customer asked to accelerate multi-region isolation. Need a minimal, auditable cutover plan we can promise in contract.

oliver (eng): Minimal plan idea: (1) region-tag routing, (2) tenant-slice mapping, (3) controlled canary pipeline. Keep KV-prefetch optional to reduce initial infra work.

nika (arch): Agreed. Add per-tenant KMS keys and a clearly defined fallback route that preserves SLOs. Also a compatibility table for model families + quantization.

ana (sales): Customer wants firm milestones or they'll push to another provider. They accept a limited pilot of 3 tenants with discounted pricing.

kevin (sre): Operational must-haves: cost cap automation for cross-region egress, circuit-breaker on spike, and runbook for rollback + evacuation.

ci-bot: New RFC draft: https://redwood.link/mr-cutover-minimal-mvp

maria (PM): Draft launch gates (proposal): 
- Functional: requests route by region tag and map to tenant slice
- Security: customer-managed KMS + encrypted at rest
- Performance: P95 region-local <= 300ms during pilot
- Resilience: fallback to variant or region with documented latency delta
- Observability: per-route token cost, latency, and egress attribution
- Quality: automated evaluation against baseline prompts; quantized models must pass gate

nika (arch): For rollout, propose: canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% over 10 days with automated rollback on quality or cost thresholds.

oliver (eng): Estimate: routing engine + policy hooks ~2 sprints; KMS + per-tenant keys ~1 sprint; canary automation ~1 sprint. Parallelize where possible.

ana (sales): I'll draft contract bullets and schedule weekly check-ins. Customer expects a mid-pilot health review.

maria (PM): Action items: Nika produce compatibility matrix + RFC by EOW; Oliver list infra deps and sprint plan; Kevin specify cost cap mechanics. We'll review at Friday roadmap sync.

kevin (sre): Flag risk: bandwidth and egress billing spike during cutover. Mitigation: enforce hard egress cap and traffic-shaping during rollout.

nika (arch): Flag risk: quantization quality regressions; tie CI eval to gate.

maria (PM): Great. If no blockers, target pilot kickoff in 6 weeks. Thanks everyone.
